name: smart-compact
description: Propose de compacter la conversation au bon moment : après un commit, des tests au vert, avant l'expiration du cache, ou quand Claude le demande

onRequest.title: When Claude asks to compact
onRequest.description: ask: show a one-click band. auto: compact as soon as the turn ends.

minPercent.title: Minimum context fill (%)
minPercent.description: Below this, no suggestion is made and Claude's requests are turned down.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: 5 for the API default, 60 if your plan uses the 1-hour cache.

idleCompact.title: Compact while idle, before the cache expires
idleCompact.description: Off: only suggest it. On: compact one minute before expiry while the summary still reads from cache.
